rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 米公共水道のPFAS請求を11.85億ドルで解決する和解に参加(2023年6月)
relations.text_en: Joined the $1.185 billion PFAS water systems settlement (June 2023)

source.label: DuPont 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the definitive agreement reached in June 2023 by Chemours, Corteva, EIDP and DuPont to comprehensively resolve all PFAS-related claims of a defined class of U.S. public water systems

relations.text: 分離契約に基づき、Chemoursなどから費用分担・補償を受ける
relations.text_en: Receives cost sharing and indemnification from Chemours under separation agreements

source.label: Corteva 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The company, pursuant to the respective Separation Agreements, is entitled to cost sharing and indemnification from The Chemours Company ("Chemours"), Dow and DuPont

companies.name: クニティ・エレクトロニクス

relations.text: DuPontから分離。Chemoursとの覚書(MOU)の義務の一部を引き継ぐ
relations.text_en: Spun out of DuPont, taking on part of its obligations under the Chemours MOU

source.label: DuPont 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: I. du Pont de Nemours and Company and The Chemours Company (the "MOU"), including with respect to the funding of the escrow account thereunder, will be contractually allocated to Qnity

companies.name: アメリカン・ウォーター・ワークス

relations.text: PFAS和解に基づきChemoursなどへの請求を提出
relations.text_en: Filed claims under PFAS settlements with Chemours and others

source.label: American Water Works 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: under settlement agreements with defendants 3M Company, The Chemours Company, Corteva, Inc.

companies.name: クロノス・ワールドワイド

relations.text: Kronosが10-Kで、主な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Kronos lists Chemours first among principal competitors

source.label: Kronos Worldwide 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors are The Chemours Company, Tronox Holdings PLC and LB Group Co.

relations.text: Tronoxが10-Kで、世界の競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Tronox lists Chemours first among global competitors

source.label: Tronox 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We face competition from global competitors with headquarters in Europe, the United States and China, including Chemours, LB Group, Kronos Worldwide Inc., and INEOS.

companies.name: ソルスティス・アドバンスト・マテリアルズ

relations.text: Solsticeが10-Kで、冷媒部門の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Solstice names Chemours among main refrigerants competitors

source.label: Solstice Advanced Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our main competitors for the RAS segment include Arkema, Chemours, Daikin, Orbia and not-in-kind alternatives.

relations.text: NLが10-Kで、子会社Kronosの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: NL names Chemours as a principal competitor of Kronos

source.label: NL Industries 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Kronos' principal competitors are The Chemours Company, Tronox Holdings PLC and LB Group Co.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
